subject: Cloud marketplace listing — commercial pass-through and billing language
messages:
From: MarketplaceOps <marketplace-legal@cloudvendor.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@resellercorp.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud listing partnership paper + standard addendum

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the intro call last week. Attached is our standard cloud marketplace partner paper and the marketplace listing addendum we ask ISVs to sign. Two commercial points to flag up front:

- We require pass-through of marketplace transaction fees at invoice time (platform fee is deducted by the marketplace, but we also ask vendors to accept a % marketplace commission to be reflected on the customer invoice).
- Billing flow: we need Redwoods' Order Form to indicate billing via the marketplace (so payments/credits flow through their billing system).

Please review and let us know if any of this will require changes to your MSA or Order Form. Attaching the partner paper and addendum for your counsel.

Attachment: cloud_marketplace_partner_paper.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: marketplace_listing_addendum_v1.docx (DOCX)

Best,
Alex Reyes
MarketplaceOps — ResellerCorp
marketplace-legal@cloudvendor.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reyes <alex@resellercorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cloud listing partnership paper + standard addendum

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clarity. I’ve looped in Marcus (Legal) and Grace (RevOps) to scope legal/billing implications on our side. High level: we are supportive of a marketplace listing but need to propose some guardrails on pass-through fees and the exact invoicing language in the Order Form.

Action items I’d like to close in the next week:
- Marcus to provide redlines to the addendum and suggested Order Form wording by Wed 6/10.
- Grace to confirm whether we can support marketplace invoicing flow without changing our current revenue recognition process.

Can you confirm whether ResellerCorp requires that the Order Form explicitly state "billing via marketplace" or whether a separate reseller billing appendix is acceptable? That detail will affect our implementation.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Cloud listing partnership paper + standard addendum — redlines

Vanessa / Grace — attached are legal's proposed redlines to the marketplace addendum and a short excerpt from our MSA for context. Key commercial/legal positions:

1) Pass-through fees: We will accept pass-through of third-party taxes and bona fide marketplace transaction fees, provided that:
   - The pass-through is itemized on the customer invoice (transparency).
   - Pass-throughs exclude any "marketing" or "delist" fees that are charged to the vendor unless specifically agreed in writing.
   - Any marketplace commission that materially increases the price to the customer requires mutual written notice and an opportunity for the customer to opt out (we cannot accept unilateral price increases imposed by the marketplace).

2) Billing flow & revenue recognition: We cannot accept language that makes Redwood the guarantor of the marketplace's collections. Order Form language should reflect that the billing entity is Redwood (for legal contract purposes) but payments may be collected by the marketplace on Redwood's behalf; require a reconciliation right and a holdback mechanism for disputed marketplace fees.

3) Indemnity / liability: We will not accept an open-ended pass-through of marketplace liability. Indemnity should be limited to third-party claims resulting from the marketplace's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

4) Data & privacy: Must include reference to our data processing addendum if the marketplace will have access to customer content or usage metrics.

5) SLA/Support: If the listing requires the marketplace to provide first-line support, we need to map support responsibilities in the Order Form to avoid double credits.

Attachments: redlines_reseller_addendum_vredline.docx (redline), MSA_excerpt_for_context.pdf (PDF)

Please review and let me know which contract terms are negotiable from ResellerCorp. If they insist on gross pass-through with no caps or reconciliation, we will need commercial approval (potential credit hold or revenue adjustment).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reyes <alex@resellercorp.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed compromise language for Order Form / listing (RDW-3482)

Alex — following internal review, attached is our proposed compromise redline for the marketplace addendum and a short extract to add to the Order Form. Highlights of the compromise:

- Pass-through: limited to third-party taxes and clearly itemized marketplace transaction fees. We will not accept automatic gross-ups to list price without written notice to both the customer and Redwood.
- Billing: Order Form will include a "Marketplace Billing Appendix" indicating that payments may be collected by ResellerCorp on behalf of Redwood; Redwood remains the contracting party for terms enforcement.
- Reconciliation: 60-day reconciliation window for marketplace-collected amounts, with a defined dispute resolution path.

Attachment: redline_proposal_20260612.pdf (PDF)

Request: Can you confirm whether ResellerCorp can live with these three points? If yes, we can circulate a final redline for signature. If there's particular language your finance team needs for collections/gross-up, send the proposed text and we'll route to finance/legal.

Timeline: our procurement team needs counter-signed doc by 6/20 to make the July listing date. Please let me know if that works.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Reyes <alex@resellercorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@resellercorp.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed compromise language for Order Form / listing (RDW-3482)

Vanessa — thanks for the fast turnaround and for looping in Marcus. Quick responses from our side: we can accept the itemization and the reconciliation window in principle. A few pushbacks:

- Our CFO asks that we retain the ability to pass marketplace fees through to the end customer as a separate line item and, in some cases, to gross-up list price when required by the marketplace platform. We understand Redwood's request for notice — can we agree to a 30-day notice period?
- Regarding the "Redwood remains the contracting party" language: finance needs explicit hold-harmless language confirming ResellerCorp won’t be on the hook for chargeback shortfalls beyond a short collection assistance period.

I'll escalate the redlines to our CFO and procurement — expect a formal counter by 6/18. If that timeline holds, we should still be able to hit the July listing target.

Thanks,
Alex Reyes
MarketplaceOps — ResellerCorp
alex@resellercorp.com
